source_reference_roles: Starter assets used only as palette, paper texture and family-identity references. Existing f5.webp and m5.webp visually inspected for silhouette exclusion.

assets.name: River Ridge
assets.description: The cream river map folds into two unequal triangular peaks, with a cobalt stream descending the front.
assets.subject: Subject: RIVER RIDGE. Transform the map into a low accordion mountain with TWO large unequal triangular peaks: tall peak on the left, smaller peak on the right, and a clear deep V notch between them. Front-facing sculptural folded paper, a broad stable zigzag base. A thick continuous cobalt river runs diagonally down the cream front face to the lower right edge. Two large muted teal land patches and only three short coral trail dashes. Fold facets are cream and pale gold, kept flat. The outer silhouette is unmistakably TWO PEAKS, broad and compact, not a rectangular sheet, not a tent, not a tree.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent raster paper-cut game collectible for the Moticos matching game, Riverside Reverie envelope. Create ONE new finished asset only, no sheet and no variants. Handcrafted flat cut-paper collage with subtle fine paper tooth, clean gently irregular scissors-cut contours, restrained layering and fold shading, no realistic cast shadow. The illustration must be wonderfully legible at 50 pixels and beautiful at 190 pixels. Broad bold shapes, very few large details, no thin ornament, no outline strokes. Palette stays warm cream, muted river teal, saturated cobalt blue, small coral red accents and ochre-gold. Square composition, centered and balanced, whole silhouette occupies about 82 percent of the square, at least 9 percent completely transparent margin on each side. Actual transparent alpha background, including every hole/opening. No words, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark, border, frame, scene backdrop, ground plane, detached objects, scenery, plants, birds, crescent moons, sails, balloons, or cage structures.

Input image 1 is the existing River Map starter, used as style, palette and material reference, not a request to redraw its rectangle. Keep its recognizable cream folded paper, broad teal organic land patches and an unmistakable wide cobalt river crossing the paper. Coral route accents may appear as a few large short dashes. The new outer silhouette must differ radically from the original flat accordion map and be a standalone whimsical folded-paper construction. Use only the map paper itself.

assets.name: River Crossing
assets.description: A single humpback map-paper bridge opens a broad arch below its cobalt river and teal banks.
assets.subject: Subject: RIVER CROSSING. Transform one cream folded map into a single broad humpback paper bridge, seen straight on with a slight view of its folded top. An iconic upside-down U silhouette with ONE huge rounded open arch cut through its lower center, and two short substantial cream paper feet. The transparent arch opening is at least one third the overall width and half the height. The broad upper bridge surface carries one thick winding cobalt river band and two simple teal land patches; three coral route dashes on one foot. A few decisive fold facets. The bridge is the entire object; no water or terrain outside its paper contour. Distinct single arch, not multiple arches, not a map rectangle.

assets.name: River Cascade
assets.description: An asymmetric terraced map tower carries a wide cobalt waterfall over three cream folds.
assets.subject: Subject: RIVER CASCADE. Transform the cream folded map into a bold ASYMMETRIC THREE-STEP paper cascade. Highest broad rectangular folded terrace at upper LEFT; a clearly lower middle ledge to the right; the lowest broad ledge extends farther RIGHT, giving a dramatic descending stair-step outer silhouette. A single wide COBALT river stripe folds over all three terraces like a blue zigzag waterfall down the cream faces, terminating flush at the lowest paper edge. Three large muted teal land shapes occupy terrace sides, two small coral route dashes. Cream folds and ochre-gold undersides. The construction is a solid stepped papercraft collectible, not a realistic landscape, no rocks, no trees, no separate water splash. Leave clear negative-space notches between step profiles.

assets.name: River Citadel
assets.description: A compact three-tower paper citadel unfolds from the map, with the river descending its tallest central fold.
assets.subject: Subject: RIVER CITADEL. Transform the cream folded map into a majestic yet minimal connected three-tower papercraft citadel. ONE tallest central broad folded tower with a sharply sloping top, flanked by TWO shorter wide side towers with angular sloping tops, leaving two deep open notches for a memorable crown-like skyline. All towers are made of the same map sheet and connected by a low wide accordion base. A bold wide cobalt river descends the center tower and bends in a clear S across the base. Big muted teal land patches on the side towers, only four large coral route dashes total. Cream front faces, modest pale-gold fold facets. This is an abstract folded-map citadel with no windows, no flags, no turrets, no roof tiles, no realistic masonry, no ornate architecture. Strong compact silhouette and only three towers.

assets.name: Ribbon Sip
assets.description: One bold cobalt S-shaped steam ribbon rises from the cream teacup.
assets.subject: Subject: RIBBON SIP. Above the exact family cream-and-gold cup, create ONE broad cobalt-blue paper steam ribbon, rising in a simple sinuous upright S from the middle of the tea opening. The ribbon makes two large turns, with a blunt gently curved end, subtly showing a muted teal underside at one fold. It is confidently thick, approximately one quarter the bowl width, not a line, smoke cloud, question mark, leaf, flame, musical note, or letter. The bowl takes the lower 42 percent of the object and the single ribbon rises into the upper part. One tiny coral strip can sit at the rim as an accent. The central S is the unique silhouette.

assets.name: Tea Chorus
assets.description: Two outward teal and coral paper curls open like a joyful duet above the cream cup.
assets.subject: Subject: TEA CHORUS. Above the exact family cream-and-gold cup, create TWO chunky steam ribbons that rise from the bowl and curl OUTWARD in opposite directions. Tall muted TEAL ribbon on the LEFT makes one large inward-tipped open curl; slightly shorter CORAL ribbon on the RIGHT makes one large outward open curl. Their lower ends cross neatly just above the opening, with one small cobalt overlap accent. Shape is like a generous asymmetric two-armed flourish with a deep open V between the ribbon tips. Broad paper strips and huge negative-space curl openings, never delicate spirals. The cream bowl takes the lower 42 percent. Exactly two main ribbons, distinct colors, no heart, no butterfly, no stems or leaves, no bird, no balloon.

assets.name: Pleated Steam
assets.description: A broad upright fan of pleated cream, teal and cobalt steam opens above the cup.
assets.subject: Subject: PLEATED STEAM. Above the exact family cream-and-gold cup, a bold broad paper STEAM FAN unfolds from a narrow pinch just inside the bowl. Exactly FIVE large tall tapered folded paper blades spread in a generous upright fan, with a stepped gently scalloped outer contour: tallest central cream blade, two cobalt/cream folded blades beside it, and shorter muted teal side blades. Coral appears only as one broad interior stripe. Treat this as one connected accordion-folded paper steam sculpture, not a flower, plant, feather, shell, crown, or greenhouse. Its silhouette is a wide expanding pentagonal fan, with clear large folds and no tiny pleats. The cream bowl sits in the lower third, fully recognizable with open gold handle. No detached confetti.

assets.name: Ribbon Reverie
assets.description: Three generous interwoven loops of cobalt, teal and coral form an airy ribbon crown above the cream cup.
assets.subject: Subject: RIBBON REVERIE. Above the exact family cream-and-gold cup, build a joyful airy sculptural crown made of exactly THREE broad interwoven paper steam LOOPS. One very tall cobalt loop in the CENTER, one shorter muted teal loop to the LEFT, one shorter CORAL loop to the RIGHT. Each loop has a truly transparent big elongated opening; the blue central opening is the largest and the loops are asymmetric and organically curved, like folded paper ribbons rising from a common twist in the tea opening. Thick broad strips, a few cream or gold undersides at folds. Distinct three-lobed vertical outer contour, easy to identify even at tiny size. The bowl takes the lower third. The ribbon structure is OPEN with much transparent negative space, not a filled fan, not a bow with trailing tails, not a hot-air balloon, not a crown with points, not greenhouse metalwork. No dangling decoration.

preparation.changes: Uniform resize of complete source canvas and transparent padding only. No crop, redraw, recolor, alpha repair, or invented illustration. Original PNGs unchanged.
preparation.starter_derivatives: r1 and t1 are deterministic reused-source derivatives for complete-family review and matching production paths; original starter source PNGs and original web assets unchanged.

review.inspection: All eight generated outputs and both original starters inspected at full raster scale. Each ten-piece family ladder reviewed at actual 50px, 76px and 190px sizes. Map motifs and clear silhouettes retained; teacup bowl and open gold handles retained. t2 blue steam and t3 teal curl have lower contrast against dark teal, while the intended cream tiles retain full contrast.
